## Purpose

Refs #610 and #603; follows the declaration direction accepted in PR #609. The user confirmed model declaration/construction and public query-result typing as the two test seams before tests.

**Result: the chosen explicit-pending forms work with real-package declarations in this narrow static proof on both SQLite and MariaDB.** No wrapper, required=True workaround, callable intersection or new descriptor coordinate was needed.

## Evidence

- Copy the actual package; add an independent optional `server_default` argument to the seven existing Text overloads and implementation signature in each backend's storage file.
- Leave bodies, return types, models/descriptors, field-specifier registration, query/transaction declarations and the explicit Row witness unchanged.
- Separate importing consumers check omission, overrides, rejected values, default/factory domains and exact Pending/Row types.
- SQL defaults alone keep inputs required, including GenCol without a Python default. Explicit `default=PENDING_GENERATION` permits omission without leaking pending markers into Row results.
- SELECT model/scalar/tuple results and single INSERT RETURNING preserve exact public shapes, including Row input rejection for INSERT.
- 10 focused parameterized checks pass: five per backend, covering the baseline rejection, clean anchor and paired clean-positive/exact-negative constructor, factory and query consumers.
- 50 marked negative diagnostic sites are rejected across both modified-package backends, plus two exact baseline declaration rejections.
- Whole copied-package ty audit: zero diagnostics. This is distinct from ordinary repository validation.
- Read-only independent evidence audit replayed all 10 checks and found no consequential missing control or overclaim.

Start at `research/split_defaults_610/README.md`. The report includes scope, replay commands, red/green evidence, the complete zero-context overlay diff and copied-package diagnostics. Harness: `tests/experimental/test_split_defaults_610.py`.

## Important limits

**Static proof only. The copied function bodies ignore the new argument; the copied package and models are never imported/executed.** Nothing here proves runtime defaults, factories, INSERT omission, metadata/DDL, database behavior, schema verification or driver/Pydantic interpretation.

The overlay retains legacy default-marker overloads. Their removal/rejection and migration behavior remain unfinished. The provisional SQL argument annotation is not a SQL compatibility validator or a newly selected schema/nullability contract. Only Text and the listed consumer cases are covered; no broader storage-capability proof or runtime-guard removal.

No production/dependency changes, per-model generated constructors, consumer Any/casts/suppression, runtime models or backend suites. The sole harness cast describes external checker JSON only. Do not merge #607 or #609 as part of this work.

## Validation

- `uv run snektest tests/experimental/test_split_defaults_610.py` — 10 passed.
- Copied-package `ty check snekql` under the repository-equivalent all-error policy — 0 diagnostics.
- `uv run ty check` — passed.
- `uv run ruff check .` — passed.
- `uv run ruff format --check .` — passed.
- Whitespace checks and all four local report links — passed.

## Proposed next step—not started

Resolve the remaining default/nullability contract and legacy-marker compatibility plan before scoping runtime implementation. The accepted pending-marker repetition is no longer an interface blocker. This research does not authorize production changes or merges.
